qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for timing case and top and bottom timing case cover screws on all engine types?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 screws: 10 Nm, M8 screws: 22 Nm, M10 screws: 47 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What torque should I apply to the front/rear end cover to crankcase bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 bolts: 10 Nm, M8 bolts: 22 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for bolts on timing case cover for M51/M41 engines?
How much torque should I apply to sealing plugs or connectors on timing case cover for M51/M41 engines?
Which engine types use the timing case cover bolt specification of M42x1.5?
What are the different screw sizes used for timing case covers and their respective torques?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 screws: 10 Nm, M8 screws: 22 Nm, M10 screws: 47 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Do the front/rear end cover to crankcase torque specifications apply to all engine types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the specifications apply to all engine types.

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque value specified for case covers in this section?
qa_pairs.answer: 65 Nm for M42x1.5 bolts on timing case cover for M51/M41 engines.

qa_pairs.question: Which component uses M20x1.5 fasteners and what is their torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Sealing plug or connector on timing case cover uses M20x1.5 fasteners torqued to 30 Nm.
